headline: Argentine Senate Approves Patent Cooperation Treaty Sought by US
summary: Argentina's Senate voted 47 to 22 to join the Patent Cooperation Treaty to satisfy a US trade pact requirement, while inserting a reservation that protects domestic pharmaceutical manufacturers.
why: Accession to international patent frameworks improves intellectual property standards for foreign investors while testing domestic generic drug manufacturing safeguards.

impacts.name: Argentine Pharmaceutical Sector
impacts.why: Adopting the international patent treaty aligns with US trade rules while retaining protections for local drug producers.
